description: Native 4-s whole-epoch sensitivity analysis incl. exploratory delta FC (06 v1.1 issue 1 item 8, §4.3, §5); run plan B approved by Josue 2026-10-17. A pre-specified sensitivity analysis, not a rescue analysis. Descriptive (06 §4.4); never assigns or revises the RESULT-001 label.

factors_changed.window: native 4-s epoch [start, start + 2000) samples, no salience selection, for every representation (06 issue 1 item 8; §4.3 step 5)
factors_changed.surrogate_realisations_k: 3 per band (06 issue 8, D1: k = 3 for the 4-s sensitivity)
factors_changed.delta_fc: exploratory rung b2_fc_delta = B2 + FC(theta, alpha, beta) + FC(delta 1-4 Hz, 171 edges, real signal), compared with B2 + FC (run plan B)

unchanged_from_exp004.epochs_and_exclusions: 06 §4.2 locked exclusions via src/preprocessing/windows.kept_epochs (same kept epochs as EXP-004); the cache check must reproduce the F-6 recount
unchanged_from_exp004.evaluability: >= 5 IED and >= 5 non-IED epochs in a common state (artifacts/dataset_audit/evaluable_recount.csv)
unchanged_from_exp004.representations: B0, B1, B2 (salience count with the pilot-fixed z*), B2 + ADJ, B2 + FC_surr, B2 + FC, PC-1 FC only; FC = wPLI theta/alpha/beta, 513 edges, §4.3 steps 1-4 and 6-8 unchanged

z_star.note: reused unchanged (run plan B default); on the 4-s epoch the per-channel peak salience is taken over the whole epoch

unchanged_from_exp004.learner: HistGradientBoostingClassifier, locked grid (16 points), max_iter 300, no early stopping; random_state = repeat seed + outer fold
unchanged_from_exp004.tuning: nested inner CV, mean within-patient same-state AUROC; ties -> simpler
unchanged_from_exp004.estimand: procedure-level within-patient same-state DeltaAUROC, equal patient weight, per-repeat Delta averaged over repeats

learner_note: primary learner only; the LR learner is its own robustness factor (06 §5) and is not crossed with the window

inference.interval: M1 (06 v1.1 §4.4; RDR-014), 90% and 95%; patient-cluster percentile bootstrap 90%/95% alongside; NB not reported
inference.heterogeneity: R6: SD of Delta_p, 95% prediction interval, range, counts beyond +/- SESOI
inference.state_strata: estimate + 95% percentile bootstrap CI, no outcome label (R10)
inference.pc1: FC-only on the 4-s window, M1 95% lower bound of mean AUROC; reported, not a gate here

reading.rule: the seven-rule taxonomy (src/evaluation/taxonomy.classify) applied to the M1 intervals is reported as a descriptive reading of the 4-s analysis only, never as a label for H-1

concordance.inconclusive: inconclusive (too imprecise to agree or disagree)

reading.delta_band: any difference between the delta rung and theta/alpha/beta is described as band/window sensitivity only
